widgets.artist_lbl:
VFX Artist
Name written into the audit log for every install, update and removal.
Change it in Settings → Artist name. Empty = your OS user name.
widgets.nuke_lbl:
Detected Nuke
Nuke installations found on this machine (or the running Nuke).
Hover for the full list with paths.
Nuke in a custom folder? Set NUKE_INSTALL_PATH.
widgets.bar:
Progress bar
Shows the progress of the running task (download, extract, pip install, update check).
Stays empty when idle.
widgets.log:
Activity log
Read-only live output of everything the installer does: downloads, files written, init.py / menu.py changes, warnings and errors.
Copy from here when reporting a problem.
widgets.split_main:
Layout
Drag the handle to resize the main area and the side panel.
Sizes are remembered between sessions.
widgets.split_left:
Layout
Drag the handle to give more room to the tabs or to the activity log.
Sizes are remembered between sessions.
widgets.tabs:
Main tabs
Install · Installed · Code Editor · Browse · Profiles · Safety & Log · Settings.
Hover a tab for what it does.
widgets.side_tabs:
Online sources
GitHub: community Nuke tools found by search.
Nukepedia: browse and deep-search nukepedia.com, with login.
widgets.reg_auto:
Automatic registration
The installer writes the init.py / menu.py registration block for the tool itself (a backup is made first).
Recommended. Takes effect after restarting Nuke.
widgets.reg_manual:
Manual registration
Files are installed only. Nothing in init.py / menu.py is touched.
You get the code to paste yourself (Installed → Show init/menu code).
Later, Register (auto) can still write it for you.
widgets.gh_q:
GitHub filter / search
Type a keyword (gizmo, stamps, roto...) and press Enter or Search.
Empty = the general list of Nuke tool repositories.
widgets.gh_refresh:
Search GitHub
Query GitHub online for Nuke tool repositories matching the filter.
Needs internet. Set GITHUB_TOKEN to avoid rate limits.
widgets.gh_list:
GitHub results
Select a repository, then Install selected — or double-click to install.
Hover an entry for its URL and description.
widgets.gh_status:
GitHub status
Result count, offline / cached notice or rate-limit message.
widgets.gh_install:
Install selected (GitHub)
Download the selected repository and install it with the current registration mode (Automatic / Manual) and the settings of the Install tab.
widgets.np_user:
Nukepedia username
Your nukepedia.com username or email. Remembered between sessions.
widgets.np_pass:
Nukepedia password
Kept in memory only — never saved to disk.
Press Enter to log in.
widgets.np_login_btn:
Login
Sign in to nukepedia.com. Nukepedia downloads need an account.
If the site blocks the login (verification), use the browser-cookie fallback below.
widgets.np_cookie_btn:
Paste browser cookie (fallback)
Log in with your normal browser, copy the Cookie header of the session and paste it here.
Use this when the login form is blocked by a verification page.
widgets.np_cat:
Nukepedia category
Same categories as nukepedia.com/tools. Choosing one lists that category immediately.
widgets.np_browse_btn:
Browse category
List the tools of the selected category.
widgets.np_q:
Deep search
Search text for Nukepedia. Press Enter or Search.
widgets.np_search_btn:
Search Nukepedia
Search for the text. With Search every category (deep) on, all categories are searched, otherwise only the selected one.
widgets.np_deep:
Search every category (deep)
On: search all Nukepedia categories.
Off: only the category selected above.
widgets.np_list:
Nukepedia results
Each entry has Install / Uninstall buttons. Hover an entry for its URL and description.
Installs go to the scope chosen below.
widgets.np_scope_btns[Global]:
Scope: Global
Nukepedia tools are installed available in every Nuke version, for everyone.
Same value as Install scope in the Install tab. Limited by your role (Settings).
widgets.np_scope_btns[Major version]:
Scope: Major version
Nukepedia tools are installed only loads in the same Nuke major version it was installed for (e.g. 15).
Same value as Install scope in the Install tab. Limited by your role (Settings).
widgets.np_scope_btns[TD level]:
Scope: TD level
Nukepedia tools are installed only loads for sessions started with NK_LEVEL=TD.
Same value as Install scope in the Install tab. Limited by your role (Settings).
widgets.np_scope_btns[Studio production level]:
Scope: Studio production level
Nukepedia tools are installed only loads in Nuke Studio sessions.
Same value as Install scope in the Install tab. Limited by your role (Settings).
widgets.source:
Source type
Where the tool comes from.
Auto-detect: decided from the path / URL you enter.
Local zip / folder: a file or folder on disk.
GitHub URL / GitLab URL: a repository (branch or release can be chosen).
Nukepedia / direct zip URL: a direct download link.
widgets.src_path:
Zip / folder / URL
Path of a zip or folder, or a GitHub / GitLab / zip URL.
You can also drag a zip or folder onto the window. Name and version are filled automatically.
widgets.browse_zip:
Choose zip...
Pick a tool .zip file from disk.
widgets.browse_dir:
Choose folder...
Pick an unpacked tool folder from disk.
widgets.ref_kind:
Branch or release
Download a branch (latest code) or a release tag (a published, stable version).
widgets.ref:
Branch / tag
Name of the branch or tag. Empty = the repository's default branch.
Use Fetch versions to fill the list.
widgets.fetch_btn:
Fetch versions
Query the repository online and list its branches or release tags.
widgets.type:
Tool type
Python · Gizmo · TCL · .nk · DLL / Plugin.
Auto-detect inspects the files and decides the registration for you.
widgets.name:
Tool folder name
Folder the tool is installed into. Automatic = from tool.json or repo / zip name.
Invalid characters are cleaned.
widgets.version:
Tool version
Sub-folder for this version. Automatic = release tag, tool.json version or the date.
Older versions are kept for rollback (see Versions to keep).
widgets.scope:
Install scope
Who the tool loads for.
Global: every Nuke.
Major version: only this Nuke major version.
TD level: sessions with NK_LEVEL=TD.
Studio production level: Nuke Studio.
The list depends on your role (Settings).
widgets.sha:
SHA-256 (optional)
Paste the publisher's checksum. The download is verified and rejected if it does not match.
Leave empty to skip.
widgets.preview:
Install destination
Exact folder the tool will be written to: root / scope / tool name / version.
widgets.review_chk:
Review first (recommended)
Show the full list of files and the planned init.py / menu.py changes before anything is written. You confirm or cancel.
widgets.req_chk:
Install requirements.txt
If the tool has a requirements.txt, run pip install for it into the tool's own _deps folder.
Needs internet. Does not touch Nuke's Python.
widgets.dry_chk:
Dry run
Show the plan only. Nothing is downloaded into the install root, nothing is written, no registration is changed.
Good for checking what an install would do.
widgets.install_btn:
Install
Install the tool with the settings above.
Disabled while a task is running. Existing init.py / menu.py are backed up first.
widgets.open_btn:
Open folder
Open the install folder (or its nearest existing parent) in your file browser.
widgets.inst_table:
Installed tools
Name tool · Active version in use · Scope · Type · Status (enabled / disabled / quarantined) · Update availability · Versions kept.
Select a row, then use the buttons below.
widgets.b_check:
Check updates
Compare installed tools with their GitHub / GitLab source.
Tools from other sources show n/a. Needs internet.
widgets.b_update:
Update
Install the newer version of the selected tool from its original source. The old version is kept for rollback.
widgets.b_roll:
Rollback...
Switch the selected tool to an older kept version.
widgets.b_toggle:
Enable / Disable
Switch the selected tool on or off without deleting it.
Enabling also clears a quarantined state. Restart Nuke to apply.
widgets.b_un:
Uninstall
Remove the selected tool and its init.py / menu.py registration block.
Backups of init.py / menu.py are made first.
Logged in Safety & Log (tool, versions, scope, folders).
widgets.b_edit:
Edit code
Open the active version's folder, including its init.py / menu.py, in the built-in Code Editor tab.
widgets.b_errors:
Check / fix errors
Scan the tool for syntax errors and jump to the first one in the Code Editor.
widgets.b_register:
Register (auto)
Write the init.py / menu.py registration for a tool installed with Manual registration.
widgets.b_code:
Show init/menu code
Display the exact init.py / menu.py code for the selected tool so you can paste it yourself.
widgets.b_open:
Open folder
Open the selected tool's folder in your file browser.
widgets.editor.b_save:
Save
Save the current file. A backup of the previous content is made automatically (Safety & Log).
widgets.editor.b_check:
Check
Check the current file for syntax errors. Problems are listed below the editor.
widgets.editor.b_check_all:
Check tool
Check every file of this tool plus init.py / menu.py.
widgets.editor.b_reload:
Reload
Discard unsaved edits and reload the file from disk.
widgets.editor.theme_box:
Editor theme
Colour theme of the code editor.
widgets.editor.find_edit:
Find in file
Ctrl+F to focus. Enter = next match, Shift+Enter = previous.
widgets.editor.tree:
File tree
Files of the selected tool. Double-click to open in a tab.
widgets.editor.tabs:
Open files
One tab per open file. Use the x to close; unsaved files ask first.
widgets.editor.problems:
Problems
Syntax errors found by Check / Check tool. Click one to jump to the line.
widgets.editor.status:
Editor status
Current file, save / backup and check messages.
widgets.search_src:
Search source
GitHub and GitLab: public repositories online.
Studio catalog: your studio's catalog.json (set in Settings).
widgets.search_q:
Search text
For example gizmo, stamps, roto. Press Enter to search.
widgets.search_btn:
Search
Run the search in the chosen source.
widgets.res_table:
Search results
Name · Stars · Last updated · Description.
Double-click a row to send it to the Install tab.
widgets.use_btn:
Use in Install tab
Fill the Install tab with the selected result so you can review and install it.
widgets.web_btn:
Open in browser
Open the selected result's page in your web browser.
widgets.prof_list:
Profiles
Saved sets of enabled tools, e.g. per show, shot or department.
widgets.p_save:
Save current as...
Save the tools that are currently enabled as a named profile.
widgets.p_apply:
Apply
Enable exactly the tools of the selected profile and disable all others. Restart Nuke afterwards.
widgets.p_del:
Delete
Delete the selected profile. Installed tools are not affected.
widgets.p_export:
Export pack...
Write a pack file listing your tools' repository URLs to share with a team. Local installs are skipped.
widgets.p_import:
Import pack (batch install)...
Install every tool listed in a pack file. You can review before it installs.
widgets.audit_table:
Audit log
Every action is recorded here: install, update, uninstall (also cancelled / failed), enable / disable, rollback, register, edit, backup restore, profiles, packs, Nukepedia login, settings and splash changes.
Newest first. Hover a row for the full details.
widgets.bk_table:
Backups
Copies of init.py / menu.py made automatically before every change.
widgets.bk_restore:
Restore selected backup
Put the selected backup back as the live init.py / menu.py. Current files are backed up first. Restart Nuke to apply.
widgets.bk_view:
View selected
Show the contents of the selected backup.
widgets.bk_open:
Open backup folder
Open the backup folder in your file browser.
widgets.s_role:
Role
artist: Global / Major version.
td: + TD level.
admin: + Studio production level.
A guard rail, not security. Locked when the NK_ROLE environment variable is set.
widgets.s_root:
Install root
Folder where tools are installed. Empty = automatic default.
widgets.s_init:
init.py / menu.py folder
Folder holding the init.py / menu.py the installer edits. Point it at a shared NUKE_PATH folder for studio-wide deployment.
widgets.s_catalog:
Studio catalog
Path or URL of your studio catalog.json. Used by Browse → Studio catalog.
widgets.s_self:
Installer update URL
GitHub / GitLab repository URL, or a zip, used by Update installer.
widgets.s_artist:
Artist name
Name shown in the header and written to the audit log. Empty = OS user name.
widgets.s_icons[1]:
Icon folder
Folder with the UI icons. Empty = automatic detection next to the installer.
widgets.s_pycharm[1]:
PyCharm executable
Path to PyCharm. Empty = automatic detection (the placeholder shows what was found).
widgets.s_sublime[1]:
Sublime Text executable
Path to Sublime Text. Empty = automatic detection (the placeholder shows what was found).
widgets.s_keep:
Versions to keep per tool
How many versions of each tool are kept for rollback (1–20). Older ones are pruned on update.
widgets.s_startup:
Check updates on start
When Nuke starts, check in the background whether installed tools have updates.
widgets.s_save:
Save settings
Save all settings. Icon and editor paths apply immediately.
widgets.s_splash:
Splash screen...
Edit the Nuke start-up splash: title, subtitle, image, colours and duration.
widgets.s_env:
NUKE_PATH snippet...
Show the NUKE_PATH line for your OS so Nuke finds the installed tools.
widgets.s_upd:
Update installer
Update Nuke Toolbox Pro itself from the update URL. Restart Nuke afterwards.
widgets.audit_filter:
Filter the audit log
Choose Uninstall to see the complete uninstall history (successful, cancelled and failed), or another group of actions. All actions shows everything.
widgets.audit_count:
Entries shown
Entries matching the filter out of all entries loaded (up to 5000, newest first).
widgets.log_del_sel:
Delete selected
Delete the selected audit entries (Ctrl / Shift-click to select several).
You are asked to confirm. A copy of the whole log is saved to audit_backups first, and the deletion is logged.
widgets.log_del_all:
Delete all shown
Delete every entry currently shown. With All actions that is the whole log; with the Uninstall filter only the uninstall log.
Confirmation required. A backup copy is kept in audit_backups, and a log-delete entry is written.

splash.title: Main splash title
splash.bg: Click to choose the background colour
splash.fg: Click to choose the text colour
splash.ms: How long the splash is shown (300–10000 ms)
splash.fit: Set the size to match the splash image
splash.author: Author line, bottom-left of the splash (name, role). Empty = hidden
